result.stdout:
Usage: [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Transpile C# types to TypeScript.

Options:
  -p, --project <string>      Path to the C# project file (.csproj) [Required]
  -o, --output <string>       Output directory for generated TypeScript files [Required]
  -t, --time                  Show compilation and transpilation timings
  -c, --clean                 Clean output directory before generating
  --package-root <string?>    Root directory of the consumer package (default: parent of --output) [Default: null]
  --dist <string>             Path (relative to packageRoot) where the JS build output lives (default: ./dist) [Default: @"./dist"]
  --skip-package-json         Skip generating/updating package.json
